summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing the upcoming release of its Q2 2026 financial results on August 11, 2026, followed by an investor webcast on August 12, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement notice with no special-situation transaction, strategic review, tender offer, or management change. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under the 1934 Act, trading on NASDAQ and TSX under 'ELE'. The announcement provides only dates, times, and registration links for the webcast. There are no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or structural mechanics stated. This is a routine scheduled disclosure event, so no special-situation classification applies.
